subject.title: cron: model override + agent-default toolsAllow silently breaks claude-cli scheduled runs; cron.run action fails even without override

question: Should toolsAllow:null in the agent cron tool mean unrestricted clearing, or reset to the creator's effective tool surface?
rationale: The documented null-to-clear behavior conflicts with the intentional security invariant that delayed jobs cannot exceed the creating agent's tool surface.

options.title: Document reset semantics
options.body: Keep creator-surface capping and change the schema and help text to say null resets to the creator's effective tool surface for agent-scoped calls.

options.title: Add authorized clear path
options.body: Allow true clearing only through a privileged CLI or Gateway API path that is not constrained by an agent creator surface.

recommendation.title: Document reset semantics
recommendation.body: Keep creator-surface capping and change the schema and help text to say null resets to the creator's effective tool surface for agent-scoped calls.
